title: Live Activities | Apple Developer Documentation - [StandBy presentation](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/live-activities\#StandBy-presentation)
claim: Use standard margins and avoid extending graphic elements to the edge of the screen.** Without standard margins, content gets cut off as the Live Activity extends, making it feel broken.
supporting_text: **Use standard margins and avoid extending graphic elements to the edge of the screen.** Without standard margins, content gets cut off as the Live Activity extends, making it feel broken.
